variant.name: ClientRedirect
variant.summary: a client redirect (JavaScript or meta refresh)

histogram.name: CriticalActions.ConversationIdDeferredResolutionOutcome.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary: Records the final resolution outcome of a deferred conversation ID resolution for a critical action triggered by {ActionSource}.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.ConversationIdResolutionOutcome.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary: Records the resolution outcome of resolving a conversation ID for a critical action triggered by {ActionSource} at the time the action is logged.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.Database.MigrationVacuumResult
histogram.summary: Records whether the SQLite VACUUM operation succeeded after migrating the CriticalActions database from schema V2 to V3 (which drops the url column). Emitted once per database migration at the end of CriticalActionDatabase::Init().

histogram.name: CriticalActions.Database.SqliteError
histogram.summary: Records SQLite result and error codes (e.g. constraint violations, disk I/O errors, corruption) encountered during SQLite operations in CriticalActionDatabase. Recorded in CriticalActionDatabase::DatabaseErrorCallback whenever a database operation or statement execution returns an error code.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.EventLogged.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary: Records the ActionType category (e.g. form fill, password manager login, federated login, download, OTP) of a critical action. Recorded in CriticalActionService::AddCriticalAction whenever a new critical action is added to the service to be persisted to the database by {ActionSource}.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.EventLoggedInRedirect.{RedirectType}.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary: Records the ActionType category of a critical action triggered by {ActionSource} whose visit is redirected to another visit by {RedirectType}. Not recorded for actions on the final visit of a redirect chain. Compare against CriticalActions.EventLogged.{ActionSource} to compute the share of critical actions logged on redirected visits.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.OpenConversationResult
histogram.summary: Records the outcome of attempting to open a Gemini conversation session associated with a critical action visit from the Chrome History page. Recorded in BrowsingHistoryHandler whenever the user clicks 'Go to Gemini chat' in the history entry menu.

histogram.name: CriticalActions.VisitIdResolutionOutcome.{ActionSource}
histogram.summary: Records the resolution outcome of resolving a navigation ID to a History Visit ID for a critical action triggered by {ActionSource}. Emitted either when the navigation ID is resolved to a Visit ID or when the pending action is dropped prior to persistence.
